company_name: 华意压缩机股份有限公司
decision_frame: Pre-cutoff enterprise underwriting of operating resilience, financing needs, owner cash and permanent-loss paths; no market price or return assumptions.
underwriting_route: Underwrite the established compressor franchise as the reference business, while conditioning non-core acquisitions and unresolved working-capital and financing transmission on later evidence.

situation_model.summary: Demand spans household and commercial refrigeration, while 2017 profitability fell as raw-material prices rose and inventory and short-term borrowing increased.

industry_future_thesis.most_likely_regime: Mature, competitive compressor manufacturing with cyclical input-cost pressure and selective diversification.
industry_future_thesis.profit_pool_transmission: Profit pools remain with scaled, reliable compressor suppliers; input inflation and customer mix determine pass-through and margins.
industry_future_thesis.company_exposure: The company is a global supplier with HUAYI, JIAXIPERA and CUBIGEL brands, concentrated in compressor production and sales.
industry_future_thesis.adaptation: Management is adding efficient/commercial lines, R&D capability and optional businesses (auto parts and cleaning robots), but their economics are not yet separable.
industry_future_thesis.normal_economics: Core earnings are exposed to steel and other raw-material costs, volume, mix and working-capital intensity; three-year reported profits provide a noisy reference.
industry_future_thesis.permanent_loss: Permanent loss could arise from sustained input-cost non-pass-through, leverage and liquidity stress, or value-destructive diversification and integration.
industry_future_thesis.valuation_treatment: Use a price-free primary route anchored to core operating earnings; treat optional businesses and unresolved cash conversion as conditional or scenario inputs.
industry_future_thesis.strongest_rival: Scaled global and regional refrigerator-compressor manufacturers with comparable brands, cost positions and customer qualification relationships.
reversal_observations: Post-cutoff official annual reports show whether compressor margins and profit recover despite raw-material costs.
Post-cutoff official annual reports show whether operating cash conversion, inventory and short-term borrowing normalize.

business_position: Design-plus-production-plus-sales model; important supplier to global refrigerator companies with three compressor brands and broad European, American, Southeast Asian and domestic customer coverage.
survival_case: 2017 operating cash flow was negative while short-term borrowings reached RMB2.021bn and restricted assets were material; survival depends on bank access, inventory discipline and timely customer collections.
adaptation_case: Funded projects target R&D, capacity upgrades and efficient/commercial compressor lines; Shanghai V?ile (automotive parts) and Gelanbo (cleaning robots) broaden options but remain small and unallocated by segment.
normalization_case: Reference normalized economics to FY2017 attributable net profit after extraordinary items (RMB60.29m) as a bounded baseline, with raw-material pass-through, mix and cash conversion kept conditional.
permanent_loss_map: Base path is competitive core manufacturing; conditional loss paths are prolonged cost inflation without pass-through, refinancing/liquidity strain, and failed diversification or integration.

value_route.route_reasoning: Only the established compressor franchise has a directly evidenced earnings baseline; optional businesses and unresolved cash commitments cannot authorize a primary value range.

strongest_rival: Scaled global and regional refrigerator-compressor manufacturers with comparable brands, cost positions and customer qualification relationships.
reversal_observations: Post-cutoff official annual reports show whether compressor margins and profit recover despite raw-material costs.
Post-cutoff official annual reports show whether operating cash conversion, inventory and short-term borrowing normalize.

component_treatments.reason: Established refrigerator and commercial compressor operations are the disclosed principal business and profit source.
component_treatments.investment_consequence: Forms the primary earnings route; monitor margin pass-through and volume.
component_treatments.promotion_or_resolution_condition: Retain when subsequent reports continue to disclose durable compressor profitability and customer demand.

component_treatments.reason: Shanghai V?ile automotive-parts acquisition is disclosed but segment economics are not separately reported.
component_treatments.investment_consequence: No base earnings or owner-cash credit; option value only in a scenario.
component_treatments.promotion_or_resolution_condition: Promote only with segment revenue, margin, cash flow and integration disclosures.

component_treatments.reason: Gelanbo cleaning-robot acquisition is disclosed without allocated operating or cash data.
component_treatments.investment_consequence: Keep outside base underwriting; test for incremental capital and integration burden.
component_treatments.promotion_or_resolution_condition: Promote only after audited segment economics and cash returns are disclosed.

component_treatments.reason: Trade and technical services are identified as small new businesses with no segment cash or balance-sheet allocation.
component_treatments.investment_consequence: Exclude from base earnings and value route.
component_treatments.promotion_or_resolution_condition: Include only when recurring scale and standalone economics become evidenced.

component_treatments.reason: Group inventory rose to RMB1.379bn and operating cash flow turned negative, but component-level cash allocation is unavailable.
component_treatments.investment_consequence: Creates unresolved owner-cash and liquidity pressure; no invented point estimate.
component_treatments.promotion_or_resolution_condition: Resolve with segment working-capital, cash-conversion and inventory ageing disclosures.

component_treatments.reason: Short-term borrowings increased to RMB2.021bn and restricted assets are material, with debt not allocated by component.
component_treatments.investment_consequence: Treat refinancing and collateral dependence as unresolved stress, not a base value input.
component_treatments.promotion_or_resolution_condition: Resolve with maturity, covenant, collateral and component-level debt disclosures.

component_decisions.invalidation_test: Sustained margin erosion or customer loss without cost pass-through.

underwriting_thesis.central_path: Underwrite the scaled compressor franchise cautiously; preserve optionality while requiring evidence before crediting diversification or cash conversion.
underwriting_thesis.normal_earnings_treatment: Use FY2017 after-tax attributable profit excluding extraordinary items as a bounded reference; keep cost pass-through and mix effects conditional.
underwriting_thesis.owner_cash_treatment: Owner cash is conditional and unresolved because operating cash flow was negative and segment working-capital and total spending are not allocated.
underwriting_thesis.permanent_loss_treatment: Monitor cost non-pass-through, leverage/liquidity and diversification failure as the principal permanent-loss paths.
underwriting_thesis.value_route_treatment: Primary route is core normal earnings; optional businesses are scenario-only and trade/technical services excluded.
underwriting_thesis.strongest_rival: Scaled global and regional refrigerator-compressor manufacturers with comparable brands, cost positions and customer qualification relationships.
underwriting_thesis.monitoring: Track raw-material prices and margin, compressor volumes/mix, inventory and receivable days, operating cash flow, short-term debt and disclosures for acquired businesses.

investment_treatment: Pre-outcome underwriting only: no price, valuation result, expected return or action; retain a conditional stance pending cash and segment evidence.

basis.metric: attributable net profit excluding non-recurring items

rows.economic_reason: FY2017 attributable net profit excluding non-recurring items is the disclosed reference baseline.
